paragraphs.source_en:
Mary published the poem in 1824 as Song, On a Faded Violet without date and based
on the Hunt MS, but in 1839 she printed a text based on the Ollier MS, though also entitled
On a Faded Violet, among the Poems Written in 1818. Why she preferred the Ollier MS in
1839 is unclear. Medwin published stanzas 2 and 3 under the Ollier MS title, To a Faded
Violet (Medwin (1913) 210). His version shows a number of variants from both the draft and
fair copies described above. Forman considered that Medwin’s version might derive from
an independent MS (Medwin (1913) 210; Murray (BSM xxi 530) suggested that Medwin’s
variants might be no more than mistranscriptions. At any rate, Medwin is not an entirely
reliable witness, and the variations in his text may be owing to lapses of memory or represent
his ‘improvements’. Variants of substance from these textual witnesses are given in the notes.
